integrity: The result is stated as a self-reviewed mathematical finding, not as independent validation. Prior literature coverage is separated from the new structural and enumerative claims, and the complete-bipartite upper bound already in the literature is not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite simple complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts. Finite brute-force verification is supplementary; the all-orders result rests on the structural proof. An unindexed equivalent observation under alternate terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Strong odd colorings of complete multipartite graphs are odd-block partitions
